source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE items 4/5 and abstract: effect of liquid nitrogen storage vs fresh lysis on four AML patients. MaxQuant FreshFrozen_SS summary.txt groups HR82_FRESH with Exp_1A and HR82_FROZEN with Exp_1B (17 -> Exp_2A/B, 23 -> Exp_3A/B, FIL -> Exp_4A/B), so suffix A = fresh, B = frozen, and HR82/17/23/FIL = patients 1-4. Independent data checks on deposited peptides.txt (fresh range-read from Search_FreshFrozen-LF.zip / Search_FreshFrozen_SS.zip; summary.txt byte-identical to cached copy): (a) patient identity: patient-centred log2 peptide profiles (7843 peptides) correlate block-diagonally between LF experiments n-A/n-B and SS light Exp_nA/nB (same-patient r = 0.28-0.74, other-patient r <= 0.19), so LF patient n = SS patient n for all four; Y-chromosome peptides appear only for patient 4 in both sets; (b) A/B orientation: per-patient (A - B) difference vectors correlate positively between LF and SS for all 16 patient pairs (diagonal 0.10-0.20, none negative), so LF -A has the same orientation as SS A (= FRESH). Cleavage: partial (first 20 MB compressed) range-read of each FreshFrozen evidence.txt covering all raw files: every LF, SS-proteome and phospho run shows a single-trypsin pattern (K-terminal 48-65%, R-terminal 34-49%, no Lys-C-eluate signature), consistent with Trypsin only and PRIDE 'FASP single digested'. Raw header folder '2015-10-18_OrbitrapElite_50cm-AML-MM-FreshFrozen' and PRIDE 'FASP fractionated with SDB-RPS plugs (mixed-mode)' support the fractionation method; MaxQuant Multiplicity 2, Labels1 'Arg6;Lys8'.
